identification: Three framed decorative pictures in ornate dark green and gilt composition frames, early 20th century: two colour chromolithograph or offset prints (birch-wood stream with deer; Regency-style young man carving a heart on a tree beside a lady in a green dress and hat, both unsigned), and a small velvet-green panel with a glitter and foil floral urn picture. Description says 3 x 1920s framed artworks, H50 W27 cm and 2 x H40 W70 cm. No artist or publisher identified.
